changeSet.author: qodiriy
changeSet.sql:
ALTER TABLE "user".session ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS uuid TEXT, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS phone TEXT, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS os_version TEXT, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS os TEXT, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS model TEXT, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS brand TEXT, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS type TEXT, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS device TEXT, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS fcm_token TEXT, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS is_verify_device BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE;
ALTER TABLE "user".session ALTER COLUMN user_id DROP NOT NULL;

changeSet.author: qodiriy
changeSet.sql: UPDATE "user".session s SET uuid = d.uuid, phone = d.phone, os_version = d.os_version, os = d.os, model = d.model, brand = d.brand, type = d.type, device = d.device, fcm_token = d.fcm_token FROM "user".device d WHERE s.device_id = d.id;

changeSet.author: qodiriy
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE "user".session DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS device_id; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS "user".device;
